theorems.name: zero_add
theorems.statement: forall n. 0 + n = n
theorems.summary: Zero is a left identity for addition; unlike PA3, this needs induction.

theorems.name: add_succ_left
theorems.statement: forall n m. S n + m = S (n + m)
theorems.summary: A successor can move through addition on the left.

theorems.name: add_comm
theorems.statement: forall n m. n + m = m + n
theorems.summary: Addition is commutative.

theorems.name: add_assoc
theorems.statement: forall n m k. (n + m) + k = n + (m + k)
theorems.summary: Addition is associative.

theorems.name: mul_zero_left
theorems.statement: forall n. 0 * n = 0
theorems.summary: Zero annihilates multiplication on the left.

theorems.name: mul_succ_left
theorems.statement: forall n m. S n * m = n * m + m
theorems.summary: A successor can move through multiplication on the left.

theorems.name: mul_comm
theorems.statement: forall n m. n * m = m * n
theorems.summary: Multiplication is commutative.

theorems.name: mul_add
theorems.statement: forall n m k. n * (m + k) = n * m + n * k
theorems.summary: Multiplication distributes over addition on the right.

theorems.name: mul_assoc
theorems.statement: forall n m k. (n * m) * k = n * (m * k)
theorems.summary: Multiplication is associative.

theorems.name: one_mul
theorems.statement: forall n. 1 * n = n
theorems.summary: One is a left identity for multiplication.

theorems.name: mul_one
theorems.statement: forall n. n * 1 = n
theorems.summary: One is a right identity for multiplication.

theorems.name: add_mul
theorems.statement: forall n m k. (n + m) * k = n * k + m * k
theorems.summary: Multiplication distributes over addition on the left.

theorems.name: succ_ne_zero
theorems.statement: forall n. ~(S n = 0)
theorems.summary: No successor is zero (the reusable PA1 lemma).

theorems.name: succ_injective
theorems.statement: forall n m. S n = S m -> n = m
theorems.summary: Successor is injective (the reusable PA2 lemma).

theorems.name: le_refl
theorems.statement: forall n. n <= n
theorems.summary: The defined order is reflexive; zero is its witness.

theorems.name: le_trans
theorems.statement: forall n m k. n <= m -> m <= k -> n <= k
theorems.summary: Order witnesses compose by addition, so the defined order is transitive.

theorems.name: no_succ_add_fixed
theorems.statement: forall p n. S p + n = n -> false
theorems.summary: Adding a positive successor cannot leave a natural number fixed.

theorems.name: drop_add_prefix_from_fixed
theorems.statement: forall a b n. (b + a) + n = n -> a + n = n
theorems.summary: A fixed-point equation remains fixed after dropping an additive prefix.

theorems.name: antisymm_from_witnesses
theorems.statement: forall a b n m. a + n = m -> b + m = n -> n = m
theorems.summary: Opposing additive witnesses force equality.

theorems.name: le_antisymm
theorems.statement: forall n m. n <= m -> m <= n -> n = m
theorems.summary: The witness-defined order is antisymmetric.

theorems.name: le_total
theorems.statement: forall n m. n <= m \/ m <= n
theorems.summary: Every pair of natural numbers is comparable in the defined order.

theorems.name: add_eq_zero_right
theorems.statement: forall a b. a + b = 0 -> b = 0
theorems.summary: A sum equal to zero has zero as its right addend.

theorems.name: mul_eq_zero
theorems.statement: forall n m. n * m = 0 -> n = 0 \/ m = 0
theorems.summary: Zero products have a zero factor: the 23-entry core capstone.

theorems.name: eq_symm
theorems.statement: forall a b. a = b -> b = a
theorems.summary: Equality is symmetric.

theorems.name: eq_trans
theorems.statement: forall a b c. a = b -> b = c -> a = c
theorems.summary: Equality is transitive.

theorems.name: succ_congr
theorems.statement: forall a b. a = b -> S a = S b
theorems.summary: Successor preserves equality.

theorems.name: zero_or_succ
theorems.statement: forall n. n = 0 \/ exists k. n = S k
theorems.summary: Every natural is either zero or the successor of a natural.

theorems.name: nonzero_is_succ
theorems.statement: forall n. ~(n = 0) -> exists k. n = S k
theorems.summary: Every nonzero natural has a predecessor.

theorems.name: add_congr
theorems.statement: forall a b c d. a = b -> c = d -> a + c = b + d
theorems.summary: Addition preserves equality in both arguments.

theorems.name: mul_congr
theorems.statement: forall a b c d. a = b -> c = d -> a * c = b * d
theorems.summary: Multiplication preserves equality in both arguments.

theorems.name: add_right_cancel
theorems.statement: forall a b c. a + c = b + c -> a = b
theorems.summary: A common right addend can be cancelled.

theorems.name: add_left_cancel
theorems.statement: forall a b c. a + b = a + c -> b = c
theorems.summary: A common left addend can be cancelled.

theorems.name: zero_le
theorems.statement: forall n. 0 <= n
theorems.summary: Zero is below every natural number.

theorems.name: le_succ_self
theorems.statement: forall n. n <= S n
theorems.summary: Every natural number is below its successor.

theorems.name: le_zero
theorems.statement: forall n. n <= 0 -> n = 0
theorems.summary: Only zero is less than or equal to zero.

theorems.name: one_le_of_ne_zero
theorems.statement: forall n. ~(n = 0) -> 1 <= n
theorems.summary: Every nonzero natural is at least one.

theorems.name: ne_zero_of_one_le
theorems.statement: forall n. 1 <= n -> ~(n = 0)
theorems.summary: A natural at least one is nonzero.

theorems.name: le_add_left
theorems.statement: forall a b. exists k. k + a = b + a
theorems.summary: Adding on the left produces an explicit order witness.

theorems.name: le_add_right
theorems.statement: forall a b. exists k. k + a = a + b
theorems.summary: Adding on the right produces an explicit order witness.

theorems.name: add_le_add_right
theorems.statement: forall a b c. (exists k. k + a = b) -> exists r. r + (a + c) = b + c
theorems.summary: Adding the same right summand preserves the witness-defined order.

theorems.name: add_le_add_left
theorems.statement: forall a b c. (exists k. k + a = b) -> exists r. r + (c + a) = c + b
theorems.summary: Adding the same left summand preserves the witness-defined order.

theorems.name: succ_le_succ
theorems.statement: forall a b. (exists k. k + a = b) -> exists r. r + S a = S b
theorems.summary: Successor preserves the witness-defined order.

theorems.name: le_of_succ_le_succ
theorems.statement: forall a b. (exists k. k + S a = S b) -> exists r. r + a = b
theorems.summary: Successor order reflects to the underlying naturals.

theorems.name: le_succ
theorems.statement: forall a b. (exists k. k + a = b) -> exists r. r + a = S b
theorems.summary: A weak inequality remains true after raising its upper bound by one.

theorems.name: lt_to_le
theorems.statement: forall a b. (exists k. k + S a = b) -> exists r. r + a = b
theorems.summary: A witnessed strict inequality entails the corresponding weak inequality.

theorems.name: add_le_cancel_right
theorems.statement: forall a b c. (exists k. k + (a + c) = b + c) -> exists r. r + a = b
theorems.summary: A common right summand can be cancelled from an order comparison.

theorems.name: lt_irrefl_expanded
theorems.statement: forall n. ~(exists k. k + S n = n)
theorems.summary: No natural is strictly below itself, with strict order fully expanded.

theorems.name: le_eq_or_lt
theorems.statement: forall a b. (exists k. k + a = b) -> a = b \/ exists k. k + S a = b
theorems.summary: A witnessed inequality is either equality or a witnessed strict inequality.

theorems.name: lt_of_lt_of_le
theorems.statement: forall a b c. (exists k. k + S a = b) -> (exists k. k + b = c) -> exists k. k + S a = c
theorems.summary: Strict order followed by weak order remains strict.

theorems.name: lt_of_le_of_lt
theorems.statement: forall a b c. (exists k. k + a = b) -> (exists k. k + S b = c) -> exists k. k + S a = c
theorems.summary: Weak order followed by strict order remains strict.

theorems.name: lt_trans
theorems.statement: forall a b c. (exists k. k + S a = b) -> (exists k. k + S b = c) -> exists k. k + S a = c
theorems.summary: Strict order is transitive.

theorems.name: le_or_lt
theorems.statement: forall a b. (exists k. k + a = b) \/ exists k. k + S b = a
theorems.summary: Any two naturals satisfy weak order in one direction or strict order in the other.

theorems.name: lt_trichotomy
theorems.statement: forall a b. a = b \/ ((exists k. k + S a = b) \/ exists k. k + S b = a)
theorems.summary: Two naturals are equal or strictly ordered in exactly one displayed direction.

theorems.name: lt_not_le
script: have hbad : forall z u v. ~(z = u + (v + S z))
theorems.statement: forall a b. (exists k. k + S a = b) -> ~ (exists k. k + b = a)
theorems.summary: A strict inequality excludes the reverse weak inequality.

theorems.name: le_not_lt
theorems.statement: forall a b. (exists k. k + a = b) -> ~ (exists k. k + S b = a)
theorems.summary: A weak inequality excludes strict inequality in the reverse direction.

theorems.name: lt_not_eq_add_middle
script: have hbad : forall z a w b. ~(z = (a + (w + S z)) + b)
theorems.statement: forall r m a b. (exists k. k + S r = m) -> ~(r = (a + m) + b)
theorems.summary: A strict upper bound prevents the lower term from containing that bound as an additive middle block.

theorems.name: mul_le_mul_left
theorems.statement: forall a b c. (exists k. k + a = b) -> exists r. r + c * a = c * b
theorems.summary: Left multiplication preserves the witness-defined order.

theorems.name: mul_le_mul_right
theorems.statement: forall a b c. (exists k. k + a = b) -> exists r. r + a * c = b * c
theorems.summary: Right multiplication preserves the witness-defined order.

theorems.name: mul_lt_mul_succ_left_nonzero
script: trans S c * a + S c
theorems.statement: forall c a. ~(c = 0) -> exists r. r + S (c * a) = c * S a
theorems.summary: Multiplication by a nonzero left factor strictly increases across a successor step.

theorems.name: division_remainder_succ
theorems.statement: forall d n. exists q r. n = S d * q + r /\ S r <= S d
theorems.summary: Every dividend has a quotient and bounded remainder for a successor divisor.

theorems.name: division_remainder_exists
theorems.statement: forall m n. ~(m = 0) -> exists q r. n = m * q + r /\ S r <= m
theorems.summary: Every positive divisor admits a quotient and a strictly bounded remainder.

theorems.name: remainder_bound_step
theorems.statement: forall r d. (exists k. k + S r = d) -> S r = d \/ exists k. k + S (S r) = d
theorems.summary: A bounded remainder either reaches the divisor or remains bounded after successor.

theorems.name: division_block_upper
theorems.statement: forall d q r. (exists k. k + S r = d) -> exists k. k + S (d * q + r) = d * S q
theorems.summary: A bounded remainder keeps its decomposition below the next divisor block.

theorems.name: positive_quotient_gap_impossible
theorems.statement: forall m q q2 r s k. (exists z. z + S r = m) -> S k + q = q2 -> ~(m * q + r = m * q2 + s)
theorems.summary: A positive gap between quotients makes two bounded-remainder decompositions unequal.

theorems.name: remainder_unique_same_quotient
theorems.statement: forall d q r s. d * q + r = d * q + s -> r = s
theorems.summary: Equal decompositions with the same quotient have equal remainders.

theorems.name: division_remainder_unique
script: have hsum : m * q + r = m * q2 + r2
theorems.statement: forall m n q r q2 r2. n = m * q + r -> (exists k. k + S r = m) -> n = m * q2 + r2 -> (exists k. k + S r2 = m) -> q = q2 /\ r = r2
theorems.summary: Bounded quotient-remainder decompositions have unique quotients and remainders.

theorems.name: zero_remainder_implies_multiple
theorems.statement: forall m n q. n = m * q + 0 -> exists k. n = m * k
theorems.summary: A quotient decomposition with zero remainder supplies a divisibility witness.

theorems.name: multiple_has_zero_remainder
theorems.statement: forall m n. ~(m = 0) -> (exists q. n = m * q) -> exists q r. (n = m * q + r /\ r = 0) /\ S r <= m
theorems.summary: Every multiple of a nonzero divisor has a bounded zero-remainder decomposition.

theorems.name: add_eq_zero_left
theorems.statement: forall a b. a + b = 0 -> a = 0
theorems.summary: A sum equal to zero has zero as its left addend.

theorems.name: add_eq_zero_components
theorems.statement: forall a b. a + b = 0 -> a = 0 /\ b = 0
theorems.summary: Both summands of a zero sum are zero.

theorems.name: mul_eq_one_components
script: have hz : S a * b + a = 0
theorems.statement: forall a b. a * b = 1 -> a = 1 /\ b = 1
theorems.summary: A product is one only when both natural factors are one.

theorems.name: mul_ne_zero
theorems.summary: A product of two nonzero naturals is nonzero.

theorems.name: mul_left_cancel_nonzero
theorems.statement: forall a b c. ~(a = 0) -> a * b = a * c -> b = c
theorems.summary: A nonzero common left factor can be cancelled.

theorems.name: mul_right_cancel_nonzero
theorems.statement: forall a b c. ~(c = 0) -> a * c = b * c -> a = b
theorems.summary: A nonzero common right factor can be cancelled.

theorems.name: two_large_factors_impossible
script: have hzero : 0 = S a * S (S b) + b
have hzero' : S a * S (S b) + b = 0
have hprod : S a * S (S b) = 0
have hz : S a = 0 \/ S (S b) = 0
theorems.statement: forall a b. ~(2 = S (S a) * S (S b))
theorems.summary: Two naturals at least two cannot multiply to two.

theorems.name: prime_two
theorems.summary: Two is prime in the expanded first-order prime predicate.

theorems.name: multiple_zero
theorems.statement: forall a. exists q. 0 = a * q
theorems.summary: Zero is a multiple of every natural number.

theorems.name: one_multiple
theorems.statement: forall n. exists q. n = 1 * q
theorems.summary: Every natural number is a multiple of one.

theorems.name: multiple_refl
theorems.statement: forall a. exists q. a = a * q
theorems.summary: Every natural number is a multiple of itself.

theorems.name: multiple_add
theorems.statement: forall a n m. (exists q. n = a * q) -> (exists r. m = a * r) -> exists s. n + m = a * s
theorems.summary: Multiples of a fixed number are closed under addition.

theorems.name: multiple_mul_right
theorems.statement: forall a n m. (exists q. n = a * q) -> exists s. n * m = a * s
theorems.summary: A right multiple of a multiple remains a multiple.

theorems.name: multiple_mul_left
script: suffices hswap : m * n = n * m
theorems.statement: forall a n m. (exists q. n = a * q) -> exists s. m * n = a * s
theorems.summary: A left multiple of a multiple remains a multiple.

theorems.name: multiple_trans
theorems.statement: forall a b n. (exists q. n = a * q) -> (exists r. a = b * r) -> exists s. n = b * s
theorems.summary: The multiple relation is transitive.

theorems.name: divisor_le_nonzero
script: have h1q : exists k. k + 1 = x
theorems.statement: forall d n. ~(n = 0) -> (exists q. n = d * q) -> exists k. k + d = n
theorems.summary: A divisor of a nonzero natural is bounded by that natural.

theorems.name: divisor_one
theorems.statement: forall d. (exists y. 1 = d * y) -> d = 1
theorems.summary: Every natural divisor of one equals one.

theorems.name: multiple_antisymm
theorems.statement: forall a b. (exists x. b = a * x) -> (exists y. a = b * y) -> a = b
theorems.summary: Mutual divisibility is antisymmetric over natural numbers.

theorems.name: factor_difference
script: have hred : c * u = c * v + r
theorems.statement: forall c u v r. c * u = c * v + r -> exists w. r = c * w
theorems.summary: A common-factor difference is itself a multiple of that factor.

theorems.name: divides_remainder
theorems.statement: forall c a b q r. (exists u. a = c * u) -> (exists v. b = c * v) -> a = b * q + r -> exists w. r = c * w
theorems.summary: A common divisor of a dividend and divisor also divides the remainder.

theorems.name: divides_linear_step
theorems.statement: forall c b q r. (exists u. b = c * u) -> (exists v. r = c * v) -> exists w. b * q + r = c * w
theorems.summary: A common divisor of a divisor and remainder divides their Euclidean linear step.

theorems.name: not_multiple_pointwise
theorems.statement: forall a n. ~(exists q. n = a * q) -> forall q. ~(n = a * q)
theorems.summary: Turn a negated existential multiple into pointwise inequalities.

theorems.name: not_multiple_from_pointwise
theorems.statement: forall a n. (forall q. ~(n = a * q)) -> ~(exists q. n = a * q)
theorems.summary: Reconstruct a negated existential from pointwise inequalities.

theorems.name: is_gcd_zero_right
theorems.statement: forall a. (((exists x. a = a * x) /\ (exists y. 0 = a * y)) /\ forall c. (exists u. a = c * u) -> (exists v. 0 = c * v) -> exists w. a = c * w)
theorems.summary: Every natural is the relational gcd of itself and zero.

theorems.name: is_gcd_symm
theorems.statement: forall g a b. (((exists x. a = g * x) /\ (exists y. b = g * y)) /\ forall c. (exists u. a = c * u) -> (exists v. b = c * v) -> exists w. g = c * w) -> ((exists x. b = g * x) /\ (exists y. a = g * y)) /\ forall c. (exists u. b = c * u) -> (exists v. a = c * v) -> exists w. g = c * w
theorems.summary: The expanded relational greatest-common-divisor specification is symmetric.

theorems.name: is_gcd_dvd_left
theorems.statement: forall g a b. (((exists x. a = g * x) /\ (exists y. b = g * y)) /\ forall c. (exists u. a = c * u) -> (exists v. b = c * v) -> exists w. g = c * w) -> exists x. a = g * x
theorems.summary: A relational greatest common divisor divides its left input.

theorems.name: is_gcd_dvd_right
theorems.statement: forall g a b. (((exists x. a = g * x) /\ (exists y. b = g * y)) /\ forall c. (exists u. a = c * u) -> (exists v. b = c * v) -> exists w. g = c * w) -> exists y. b = g * y
theorems.summary: A relational greatest common divisor divides its right input.

theorems.name: is_gcd_greatest
theorems.statement: forall g a b c. (((exists x. a = g * x) /\ (exists y. b = g * y)) /\ forall d. (exists u. a = d * u) -> (exists v. b = d * v) -> exists w. g = d * w) -> (exists u. a = c * u) -> (exists v. b = c * v) -> exists w. g = c * w
theorems.summary: Every common divisor of the inputs divides their relational gcd.

theorems.name: is_gcd_of_dvd
theorems.statement: forall a b. (exists y. b = a * y) -> (((exists x. a = a * x) /\ (exists y. b = a * y)) /\ forall c. (exists u. a = c * u) -> (exists v. b = c * v) -> exists w. a = c * w)
theorems.summary: If the left input divides the right, the left input is their relational gcd.

theorems.name: is_gcd_unique
script: have hdg : exists w. g = h * w
have gdh : exists w. h = g * w
theorems.statement: forall g h a b. (((exists x. a = g * x) /\ (exists y. b = g * y)) /\ forall c. (exists u. a = c * u) -> (exists v. b = c * v) -> exists w. g = c * w) -> (((exists x. a = h * x) /\ (exists y. b = h * y)) /\ forall c. (exists u. a = c * u) -> (exists v. b = c * v) -> exists w. h = c * w) -> g = h
theorems.summary: The fully expanded relational greatest common divisor is unique.

theorems.name: is_gcd_euclid_forward
theorems.statement: forall d a b q r. a = b * q + r -> (((exists x. b = d * x) /\ (exists y. r = d * y)) /\ forall c. (exists u. b = c * u) -> (exists v. r = c * v) -> exists w. d = c * w) -> (((exists x. a = d * x) /\ (exists y. b = d * y)) /\ forall c. (exists u. a = c * u) -> (exists v. b = c * v) -> exists w. d = c * w)
theorems.summary: A relational gcd of divisor and remainder is a gcd of dividend and divisor.

theorems.name: is_gcd_euclid_backward
theorems.statement: forall d a b q r. a = b * q + r -> (((exists x. a = d * x) /\ (exists y. b = d * y)) /\ forall c. (exists u. a = c * u) -> (exists v. b = c * v) -> exists w. d = c * w) -> (((exists x. b = d * x) /\ (exists y. r = d * y)) /\ forall c. (exists u. b = c * u) -> (exists v. r = c * v) -> exists w. d = c * w)
theorems.summary: A relational gcd of dividend and divisor is a gcd of divisor and remainder.

theorems.name: gcd_exists_up_to
script: have hsplit : b = S B \/ exists k. k + S b = S B
have hdiv : exists q r. a = b * q + r /\ exists k. k + S r = b
have hrB : exists k. k + x1 = B
have hsmall : exists d. (((exists u. b = d * u) /\ (exists v. x1 = d * v)) /\ forall c. (exists s. b = c * s) -> (exists t. x1 = c * t) -> exists w. d = c * w)
have hall : forall z. exists d. (((exists u. z = d * u) /\ (exists v. x1 = d * v)) /\ forall c. (exists s. z = c * s) -> (exists t. x1 = c * t) -> exists w. d = c * w)
have hbB : exists k. k + b = B
have hall : forall z. exists d. (((exists u. z = d * u) /\ (exists v. b = d * v)) /\ forall c. (exists s. z = c * s) -> (exists t. b = c * t) -> exists w. d = c * w)
theorems.statement: forall B b. (exists t. t + b = B) -> forall a. exists d. (((exists x. a = d * x) /\ (exists y. b = d * y)) /\ forall c. (exists u. a = c * u) -> (exists v. b = c * v) -> exists w. d = c * w)
theorems.summary: Bounded induction constructs a relational gcd whenever the right input is at most the bound.

theorems.name: gcd_exists_relational
script: have hbb : exists t. t + b = b
have hall : forall z. exists d. (((exists x. z = d * x) /\ (exists y. b = d * y)) /\ forall c. (exists u. z = c * u) -> (exists v. b = c * v) -> exists w. d = c * w)
theorems.statement: forall a b. exists d. (((exists x. a = d * x) /\ (exists y. b = d * y)) /\ forall c. (exists u. a = c * u) -> (exists v. b = c * v) -> exists w. d = c * w)
theorems.summary: Every pair of naturals has a relational greatest common divisor.

theorems.name: coprime_symm
theorems.statement: forall a b. (forall d. (exists x. a = d * x) -> (exists y. b = d * y) -> d = 1) -> forall c. (exists u. b = c * u) -> (exists v. a = c * v) -> c = 1
theorems.summary: Coprimality in its expanded common-divisor form is symmetric.

theorems.name: coprime_one_right
theorems.statement: forall a d. (exists x. a = d * x) -> (exists y. 1 = d * y) -> d = 1
theorems.summary: Every natural is coprime to one in the expanded common-divisor relation.

theorems.name: coprime_one_left
theorems.statement: forall a d. (exists x. 1 = d * x) -> (exists y. a = d * y) -> d = 1
theorems.summary: One is coprime to every natural in the expanded common-divisor relation.

theorems.name: coprime_to_is_gcd_one
theorems.statement: forall a b. (forall d. (exists x. a = d * x) -> (exists y. b = d * y) -> d = 1) -> (((exists x. a = 1 * x) /\ (exists y. b = 1 * y)) /\ forall c. (exists u. a = c * u) -> (exists v. b = c * v) -> exists w. 1 = c * w)
theorems.summary: Expanded coprimality constructs the relational gcd witness one.

theorems.name: is_gcd_one_to_coprime
script: have hd : exists w. 1 = c * w
theorems.statement: forall a b. (((exists x. a = 1 * x) /\ (exists y. b = 1 * y)) /\ forall d. (exists u. a = d * u) -> (exists v. b = d * v) -> exists w. 1 = d * w) -> forall c. (exists u. a = c * u) -> (exists v. b = c * v) -> c = 1
theorems.summary: A relational gcd witness one implies expanded coprimality.

theorems.name: add_permute_outer
theorems.statement: forall a b c d. (a + b) + (c + d) = (c + b) + (a + d)
theorems.summary: Permute the outer entries of two additive pairs.

theorems.name: balanced_bezout_euclid_step
script: trans ((b * q) * yp + r * yp) + b * (xp + q * yn)
trans ((b * q) * yp + r * yp) + (b * xp + b * (q * yn))
trans ((b * q) * yp + r * yp) + (b * xp + (b * q) * yn)
trans (b * xp + r * yp) + ((b * q) * yp + (b * q) * yn)
trans (b * xp + r * yp) + ((b * q) * yn + (b * q) * yp)
trans (d + (b * xn + r * yn)) + ((b * q) * yn + (b * q) * yp)
trans d + ((b * xn + r * yn) + ((b * q) * yn + (b * q) * yp))
trans d + (((b * q) * yn + r * yn) + (b * xn + (b * q) * yp))
trans d + ((b * q + r) * yn + (b * xn + (b * q) * yp))
trans d + ((b * q + r) * yn + (b * xn + b * (q * yp)))
theorems.statement: forall a b q r d xp yp xn yn. a = b * q + r -> b * xp + r * yp = d + (b * xn + r * yn) -> a * yp + b * (xp + q * yn) = d + (a * yn + b * (xn + q * yp))
theorems.summary: Transport balanced natural Bezout coefficients across one Euclidean division step.

theorems.name: gcd_balanced_bezout_exists_up_to
script: have hsplit : b = S B \/ exists k. k + S b = S B
have hdiv : exists q r. a = b * q + r /\ exists k. k + S r = b
have hrB : exists k. k + x1 = B

have hsmall : exists d. ((((exists u. b = d * u) /\ (exists v. x1 = d * v)) /\ forall c. (exists s. b = c * s) -> (exists t. x1 = c * t) -> exists w. d = c * w) /\ exists xp yp xn yn. b * xp + x1 * yp = d + (b * xn + x1 * yn))

have hall : forall z. exists d. ((((exists u. z = d * u) /\ (exists v. x1 = d * v)) /\ forall c. (exists s. z = c * s) -> (exists t. x1 = c * t) -> exists w. d = c * w) /\ exists xp yp xn yn. z * xp + x1 * yp = d + (z * xn + x1 * yn))
have hbB : exists k. k + b = B

have hall : forall z. exists d. ((((exists u. z = d * u) /\ (exists v. b = d * v)) /\ forall c. (exists s. z = c * s) -> (exists t. b = c * t) -> exists w. d = c * w) /\ exists xp yp xn yn. z * xp + b * yp = d + (z * xn + b * yn))
theorems.statement: forall B b. (exists t. t + b = B) -> forall a. exists d. ((((exists x. a = d * x) /\ (exists y. b = d * y)) /\ forall c. (exists u. a = c * u) -> (exists v. b = c * v) -> exists w. d = c * w) /\ exists xp yp xn yn. a * xp + b * yp = d + (a * xn + b * yn))
theorems.summary: Bounded Euclidean descent simultaneously constructs a relational gcd and balanced natural Bezout witnesses.

theorems.name: gcd_balanced_bezout_exists
script: have hbb : exists t. t + b = b

have hall : forall z. exists d. ((((exists x. z = d * x) /\ (exists y. b = d * y)) /\ forall c. (exists u. z = c * u) -> (exists v. b = c * v) -> exists w. d = c * w) /\ exists xp yp xn yn. z * xp + b * yp = d + (z * xn + b * yn))
theorems.statement: forall a b. exists d. ((((exists x. a = d * x) /\ (exists y. b = d * y)) /\ forall c. (exists u. a = c * u) -> (exists v. b = c * v) -> exists w. d = c * w) /\ exists xp yp xn yn. a * xp + b * yp = d + (a * xn + b * yn))
theorems.summary: Every pair has a relational gcd together with balanced natural Bezout witnesses.

theorems.name: balanced_combination_scale_right
script: trans d * z + (a * xn + b * yn) * z
trans d * z + ((a * xn) * z + (b * yn) * z)
trans d * z + (a * (xn * z) + (b * yn) * z)
theorems.statement: forall a b d xp yp xn yn z. a * xp + b * yp = d + (a * xn + b * yn) -> a * (xp * z) + (b * z) * yp = d * z + (a * (xn * z) + (b * z) * yn)
theorems.summary: Scale a balanced natural combination on the right.

theorems.name: common_divisor_divides_balanced_result
script: trans ((c * x) * xn + (c * x1) * yn) + d
theorems.statement: forall c a b d xp yp xn yn. (exists u. a = c * u) -> (exists v. b = c * v) -> a * xp + b * yp = d + (a * xn + b * yn) -> exists w. d = c * w
theorems.summary: Every common divisor of two inputs divides the result of a balanced natural combination.

theorems.name: coprime_balanced_bezout
script: have hgb : exists d. ((((exists x. a = d * x) /\ (exists y. b = d * y)) /\ forall c. (exists u. a = c * u) -> (exists v. b = c * v) -> exists w. d = c * w) /\ exists xp yp xn yn. a * xp + b * yp = d + (a * xn + b * yn))
theorems.statement: forall a b. (forall d. (exists x. a = d * x) -> (exists y. b = d * y) -> d = 1) -> exists xp yp xn yn. a * xp + b * yp = 1 + (a * xn + b * yn)
theorems.summary: Coprime inputs admit balanced natural Bezout coefficients with result one.

theorems.name: gauss_coprime_cancel
script: have hbez : exists xp yp xn yn. a * xp + b * yp = 1 + (a * xn + b * yn)
have hscaled : a * (x * z) + (b * z) * x1 = 1 * z + (a * (x2 * z) + (b * z) * x3)
theorems.statement: forall a b z. (forall d. (exists x. a = d * x) -> (exists y. b = d * y) -> d = 1) -> (exists q. b * z = a * q) -> exists w. z = a * w
theorems.summary: Cancel a coprime factor from a divisibility witness (Gauss cancellation).

theorems.name: eq_decidable
theorems.statement: forall a b. a = b \/ ~(a = b)
theorems.summary: Equality of natural numbers is constructively decidable.

theorems.name: multiple_decidable_nonzero
script: have hdiv : exists q r. n = d * q + r /\ S r <= d
have hzero : exists q r. ((n = d * q + r /\ r = 0) /\ S r <= d)
have huniq : x = x2 /\ x1 = x3
theorems.statement: forall d n. ~(d = 0) -> (exists q. n = d * q) \/ ~(exists q. n = d * q)
theorems.summary: Divisibility by a nonzero natural is constructively decidable.

theorems.name: multiple_decidable
theorems.statement: forall d n. (exists q. n = d * q) \/ ~(exists q. n = d * q)
theorems.summary: Divisibility of natural numbers is constructively decidable, including the zero divisor case.

theorems.name: factor_property_succ
script: have hsplit : c = S B \/ exists k. k + S c = S B
have hcB : exists k. k + c = B
theorems.statement: forall B n. (forall c d. (exists k. k + c = B) -> n = c * d -> c = 1 \/ d = 1) -> (forall d. n = S B * d -> S B = 1 \/ d = 1) -> forall c d. (exists k. k + c = S B) -> n = c * d -> c = 1 \/ d = 1
theorems.summary: Extend a bounded prime factor-pair property by checking the new boundary.

theorems.name: factor_search_up_to
script: have hprev : (forall c d. (exists k. k + c = B) -> n = c * d -> c = 1 \/ d = 1) \/ exists c d. ((((exists k. k + c = B) /\ ~(c = 1)) /\ ~(d = 1)) /\ n = c * d)
have hdiv : (exists q. n = S B * q) \/ ~(exists q. n = S B * q)
theorems.statement: forall B n. ~(n = 0) -> ((forall c d. (exists k. k + c = B) -> n = c * d -> c = 1 \/ d = 1) \/ exists c d. ((((exists k. k + c = B) /\ ~(c = 1)) /\ ~(d = 1)) /\ n = c * d))
theorems.summary: Constructively decide whether a nonzero natural has a bounded nontrivial factor pair.

theorems.name: prime_or_composite
script: have hsearch : (forall c d. (exists k. k + c = n) -> n = c * d -> c = 1 \/ d = 1) \/ exists c d. ((((exists k. k + c = n) /\ ~(c = 1)) /\ ~(d = 1)) /\ n = c * d)
theorems.summary: Every nonzero nonunit natural is constructively prime or has a nontrivial factor pair.

theorems.name: prime_nonzero
theorems.statement: forall p. (~(p = 1) /\ forall a b. p = a * b -> a = 1 \/ b = 1) -> ~(p = 0)
theorems.summary: Every prime natural is nonzero.

theorems.name: prime_decidable
script: have hkind : ((~(n = 1) /\ forall a b. n = a * b -> a = 1 \/ b = 1) \/ exists c d. ((~(c = 1) /\ ~(d = 1)) /\ n = c * d))
theorems.statement: forall n. ((~(n = 1) /\ forall a b. n = a * b -> a = 1 \/ b = 1) \/ ~((~(n = 1) /\ forall a b. n = a * b -> a = 1 \/ b = 1)))
theorems.summary: Primality of every natural number is constructively decidable.

theorems.name: factor_nonzero_left
theorems.statement: forall n c d. ~(n = 0) -> n = c * d -> ~(c = 0)
theorems.summary: The left factor of a nonzero product is nonzero.

theorems.name: proper_factor_lt
script: have hle : exists k. k + c = n
have hcases : c = n \/ exists k. k + S c = n
theorems.statement: forall n c d. ~(n = 0) -> n = c * d -> ~(d = 1) -> exists k. k + S c = n
theorems.summary: A factor with a nonunit cofactor is strictly smaller than a nonzero product.

theorems.name: prime_divisor_exists_up_to
script: have hpc : (~(n = 1) /\ forall a b. n = a * b -> a = 1 \/ b = 1) \/ exists c d. ((~(c = 1) /\ ~(d = 1)) /\ n = c * d)
have hcn : exists k. k + S x = n
have hcSB : exists k. k + S x = S B
have hcB : exists k. k + x = B
have hp : exists p. ((~(p = 1) /\ forall a b. p = a * b -> a = 1 \/ b = 1) /\ exists k. x = p * k)
theorems.statement: forall B n. (exists t. t + n = B) -> ~(n = 0) -> ~(n = 1) -> exists p. ((~(p = 1) /\ forall a b. p = a * b -> a = 1 \/ b = 1) /\ exists k. n = p * k)
theorems.summary: Bounded strong induction constructs a prime divisor of every nonzero nonunit natural.

theorems.name: prime_divisor_exists
theorems.statement: forall n. ~(n = 0) -> ~(n = 1) -> exists p. ((~(p = 1) /\ forall a b. p = a * b -> a = 1 \/ b = 1) /\ exists k. n = p * k)
theorems.summary: Every nonzero nonunit natural has a prime divisor.

theorems.name: prime_divisor_eq_one_or_self
theorems.statement: forall p g. (~(p = 1) /\ forall c d. p = c * d -> c = 1 \/ d = 1) -> (exists x. p = g * x) -> g = 1 \/ p = g
theorems.summary: Every divisor of a prime is one or the prime itself.

theorems.name: euclid_prime_dvd_product
script: have hg : exists g. (((exists x. p = g * x) /\ (exists y. a = g * y)) /\ forall c. (exists u. p = c * u) -> (exists v. a = c * v) -> exists w. g = c * w)
have hgfull : (((exists u. p = x * u) /\ (exists v. a = x * v)) /\ forall c. (exists s. p = c * s) -> (exists t. a = c * t) -> exists w. x = c * w)
have hcop : forall d. (exists u. p = d * u) -> (exists v. a = d * v) -> d = 1
have hg1 : (((exists u. p = 1 * u) /\ (exists v. a = 1 * v)) /\ forall c. (exists s. p = c * s) -> (exists t. a = c * t) -> exists w. 1 = c * w)
theorems.statement: forall p a b. (~(p = 1) /\ forall c d. p = c * d -> c = 1 \/ d = 1) -> (exists k. a * b = p * k) -> (exists u. a = p * u) \/ exists v. b = p * v
theorems.summary: A prime dividing a product divides at least one factor (Euclid's lemma).

theorems.name: mod_eq_refl
theorems.statement: forall m a. exists u v. a + m * u = a + m * v
theorems.summary: Balanced natural congruence is reflexive.

theorems.name: mod_eq_symm
theorems.statement: forall m a b. (exists u v. a + m * u = b + m * v) -> exists r s. b + m * r = a + m * s
theorems.summary: Balanced natural congruence is symmetric.

theorems.name: mod_eq_trans
theorems.statement: forall m a b c. (exists u v. a + m * u = b + m * v) -> (exists r s. b + m * r = c + m * s) -> exists x y. a + m * x = c + m * y
theorems.summary: Balanced natural congruence is transitive.

theorems.name: mod_eq_add
theorems.statement: forall m a b c d. (exists u v. a + m * u = b + m * v) -> (exists r s. c + m * r = d + m * s) -> exists x y. (a + c) + m * x = (b + d) + m * y
theorems.summary: Balanced natural congruence respects addition.

theorems.name: mod_eq_mul_right
theorems.statement: forall m a b c. (exists u v. a + m * u = b + m * v) -> exists r s. (a * c) + m * r = (b * c) + m * s
theorems.summary: Balanced congruence is preserved by multiplication on the right.

theorems.name: mod_eq_mul_left
script: have hr : exists r s. (a * c) + m * r = (b * c) + m * s
theorems.statement: forall m a b c. (exists u v. a + m * u = b + m * v) -> exists r s. (c * a) + m * r = (c * b) + m * s
theorems.summary: Balanced congruence is preserved by multiplication on the left.

theorems.name: mod_eq_mul
script: have hacbc : exists r s. (a * c) + m * r = (b * c) + m * s
have hbcbd : exists r s. (b * c) + m * r = (b * d) + m * s
theorems.statement: forall m a b c d. (exists u v. a + m * u = b + m * v) -> (exists r s. c + m * r = d + m * s) -> exists x y. (a * c) + m * x = (b * d) + m * y
theorems.summary: Balanced natural congruence respects multiplication.

theorems.name: remainder_decomposition_to_mod_eq
theorems.statement: forall m b q x. b = q * m + x -> exists u v. b + m * u = x + m * v
theorems.summary: A directed quotient/remainder equation gives balanced congruence to its remainder.

theorems.name: mod_eq_bounded_unique
script: have hda : a + m * x = m * x + a
have hdb : a + m * x = m * x1 + b
have huniq : x = x1 /\ a = b
theorems.statement: forall m a b. (exists ha. ha + S a = m) -> (exists hb. hb + S b = m) -> (exists u v. a + m * u = b + m * v) -> a = b
theorems.summary: Two balanced-congruent values below the same modulus are equal.

theorems.name: mod_eq_to_remainder_decomposition
script: have hdiv : exists q r. b = m * q + r /\ exists h. h + S r = m
have hremb : exists u v. x2 + m * u = b + m * v
have hremx : exists u v. x2 + m * u = x + m * v
theorems.statement: forall m b x. ~(m = 0) -> (exists h. h + S x = m) -> (exists u v. b + m * u = x + m * v) -> exists q. b = q * m + x
theorems.summary: A bounded balanced residue has a directed quotient/remainder witness.

theorems.name: beta_modulus_nonzero
theorems.statement: forall c i. ~(S ((S i) * c) = 0)
theorems.summary: Every Gödel-beta decoding modulus is nonzero.

theorems.name: beta_at_self_of_bound
theorems.statement: forall c i x. (exists h. h + S x = S ((S i) * c)) -> ((exists h. h + S x = S ((S i) * c)) /\ exists q. x = q * S ((S i) * c) + x)
theorems.summary: A value below a Gödel-beta modulus decodes to itself when used as the code.

theorems.name: beta_at_exists
script: have hdiv : exists q r. b = S ((S i) * c) * q + r /\ exists h. h + S r = S ((S i) * c)
trans S ((S i) * c) * x + x1
theorems.statement: forall b c i. exists x. ((exists h. h + S x = S ((S i) * c)) /\ exists q. b = q * S ((S i) * c) + x)
theorems.summary: Every Gödel-beta position has a bounded decoded residue.

theorems.name: beta_at_unique
script: have hdx : b = S ((S i) * c) * x1 + x
trans x1 * S ((S i) * c) + x
have hdy : b = S ((S i) * c) * x2 + y
trans x2 * S ((S i) * c) + y
have huniq : x1 = x2 /\ x = y
theorems.statement: forall b c i x y. ((exists h. h + S x = S ((S i) * c)) /\ exists q. b = q * S ((S i) * c) + x) -> ((exists h. h + S y = S ((S i) * c)) /\ exists q. b = q * S ((S i) * c) + y) -> x = y
theorems.summary: The decoded residue at a Gödel-beta position is unique.

theorems.name: beta_at_exists_unique
script: have hx : exists x. ((exists h. h + S x = S ((S i) * c)) /\ exists q. b = q * S ((S i) * c) + x)
theorems.statement: forall b c i. exists x. (((exists h. h + S x = S ((S i) * c)) /\ exists q. b = q * S ((S i) * c) + x) /\ forall y. ((exists h. h + S y = S ((S i) * c)) /\ exists q. b = q * S ((S i) * c) + y) -> x = y)
theorems.summary: Every Gödel-beta position has exactly one decoded residue.

theorems.name: beta_at_to_mod_eq
theorems.statement: forall b c i x. ((exists h. h + S x = S ((S i) * c)) /\ exists q. b = q * S ((S i) * c) + x) -> exists u v. b + S ((S i) * c) * u = x + S ((S i) * c) * v
theorems.summary: Every expanded Gödel-beta value is balanced-congruent to its code.

theorems.name: beta_at_of_mod_eq_bound
theorems.statement: forall b c i x. (exists h. h + S x = S ((S i) * c)) -> (exists u v. b + S ((S i) * c) * u = x + S ((S i) * c) * v) -> ((exists h. h + S x = S ((S i) * c)) /\ exists q. b = q * S ((S i) * c) + x)
theorems.summary: A bounded value congruent to a code is its expanded Gödel-beta value.

theorems.name: dvd_to_mod_zero
theorems.statement: forall m a. (exists k. a = m * k) -> exists u v. a + m * u = 0 + m * v
theorems.summary: A multiple is balanced-congruent to zero.

theorems.name: add_residue
theorems.statement: forall a u c r s. r = a * c + s -> a * u + r = a * (u + c) + s
theorems.summary: Absorb a second quotient into an existing residue equation.

theorems.name: add_residue_lift
script: trans a * u + ((r + a * q) + t)
trans a * u + ((a * q + r) + t)
theorems.statement: forall a x u r q t c s. x = a * q + t -> r + t = a * c + s -> (a * u + r) + x = a * ((u + q) + c) + s
theorems.summary: Combine two quotient-and-residue summands and normalize the residue.

theorems.name: square_decomp
script: trans a * (q * z) + r * (a * q + r)
trans a * (q * z) + (r * (a * q) + r * r)
trans a * (q * z) + (a * (r * q) + r * r)
trans (a * (q * z) + a * (r * q)) + r * r
theorems.statement: forall a z q r. z = a * q + r -> z * z = a * (q * z + r * q) + r * r
theorems.summary: Expand a square while retaining an explicit quotient and remainder.

theorems.name: square_residue_lift
script: trans a * (q * z + r * q) + r * r
theorems.statement: forall a z q r c s. z = a * q + r -> r * r = a * c + s -> z * z = a * ((q * z + r * q) + c) + s
theorems.summary: Lift one quotient-and-remainder equation through squaring.

theorems.name: square_residue_witness
theorems.statement: forall a z q r c s. z = a * q + r -> r * r = a * c + s -> exists w. z * z = a * w + s
theorems.summary: Existential wrapper for the generic square-residue lift.

theorems.name: bezout_mod_left
theorems.statement: forall m n xp yp xn yn. m * xp + n * yp = 1 + (m * xn + n * yn) -> exists u v. n * yp + m * u = (1 + n * yn) + m * v
theorems.summary: A balanced Bezout identity selects the right coefficient modulo the left modulus.

theorems.name: bezout_mod_right
theorems.statement: forall m n xp yp xn yn. m * xp + n * yp = 1 + (m * xn + n * yn) -> exists u v. m * xp + n * u = (1 + m * xn) + n * v
theorems.summary: A balanced Bezout identity selects the left coefficient modulo the right modulus.

theorems.name: mod_eq_predecessor_cancel
theorems.statement: forall k a z. exists u v. ((a + z) + k * z) + S k * u = a + S k * v

(exists h. h + S i = l) -> ((exists h. h + S p = S ((S i) * c)) /\ exists w. b = w * S ((S i) * c) + p) -> ((exists h. h + S q = S ((S i) * e)) /\ exists w. d = w * S ((S i) * e) + q) -> p = q)
theorems.summary: Exact catalog finite prime-factorization uniqueness target.

theorems.name: prime_three
script: have hlarge : forall x y. ~(3 = S (S x) * S (S y))
have hone : 1 = S x * S (S y) + y
have hysplit : y = 0 \/ exists z. y = S z
have hzero : 0 = S x * S (S (S x1)) + x1
have hsumzero : S x * S (S (S x1)) + x1 = 0
have hprodzero : S x * S (S (S x1)) = 0
have hfactors : S x = 0 \/ S (S (S x1)) = 0
theorems.summary: Three is prime in the expanded first-order prime predicate.

theorems.name: two_prime_product_uniqueness
script: have hpdiv : exists k. r * s = p * k
have hcases : (exists u. r = p * u) \/ exists v. s = p * v
theorems.statement: forall p q r s. (~(p = 1) /\ forall a b. p = a * b -> a = 1 \/ b = 1) -> (~(q = 1) /\ forall c d. q = c * d -> c = 1 \/ d = 1) -> (~(r = 1) /\ forall e f. r = e * f -> e = 1 \/ f = 1) -> (~(s = 1) /\ forall g h. s = g * h -> g = 1 \/ h = 1) -> p * q = r * s -> (p = r /\ q = s) \/ (p = s /\ q = r)
theorems.summary: A product of two primes determines its factors up to swapping them.

theorems.name: fourth_power_regroup
theorems.statement: forall n. n * n * n * n = (n * n) * (n * n)
theorems.summary: Regroup a fourth power as the square of a square.

theorems.name: mod5_residue_complete
theorems.statement: forall n. exists q. n = 5 * q \/ n = 5 * q + 1 \/ n = 5 * q + 2 \/ n = 5 * q + 3 \/ n = 5 * q + 4
theorems.summary: Every natural number has one of the five canonical residues modulo five.

theorems.name: mod5_nonzero_residue_cases
theorems.statement: forall n. ~(exists q. n = 5 * q) -> exists q. n = 5 * q + 1 \/ n = 5 * q + 2 \/ n = 5 * q + 3 \/ n = 5 * q + 4
theorems.summary: A nonmultiple of five lies in one of the four nonzero residue classes.

theorems.name: mod5_square_residue_one
theorems.statement: forall z q. z = 5 * q + 1 -> z * z = 5 * (q * z + q) + 1
theorems.summary: Squaring residue one modulo five preserves residue one.

theorems.name: mod5_square_residue_two
theorems.statement: forall z q. z = 5 * q + 2 -> z * z = 5 * ((q * z + q) + q) + 4
theorems.summary: Squaring residue two modulo five gives residue four.

theorems.name: mod5_square_residue_three
theorems.summary: Squaring residue three modulo five gives residue four.

theorems.name: mod5_square_residue_four
theorems.summary: Squaring residue four modulo five gives residue one.

theorems.name: mod5_fourth_power_residue_one
theorems.summary: A number congruent to one modulo five has fourth power congruent to one.

theorems.name: mod5_fourth_power_residue_two
theorems.summary: A number congruent to two modulo five has fourth power congruent to one.

theorems.name: mod5_fourth_power_residue_three
theorems.summary: A number congruent to three modulo five has fourth power congruent to one.

theorems.name: mod5_fourth_power_residue_four
theorems.summary: A number congruent to four modulo five has fourth power congruent to one.

theorems.name: mod5_fourth_power_one
script: have hsquare : n * n = 5 * ((x * n + 1 * x) + 0) + 1
have hsquare : n * n = 5 * ((x * n + 2 * x) + 0) + 4
have hsquare : n * n = 5 * ((x * n + 3 * x) + 1) + 4
have hsquare : n * n = 5 * ((x * n + 4 * x) + 3) + 1
theorems.statement: forall n. ~(exists x. n = 5 * x) -> exists x. n * n * n * n = 5 * x + 1
theorems.summary: A fourth power of a nonmultiple of five is one modulo five.

theorems.name: parity_cases
theorems.statement: forall n. exists k. n = 2 * k \/ n = 2 * k + 1
theorems.summary: Every natural has a constructive even-or-odd witness.

theorems.name: even_odd_exclusive_pointwise
theorems.statement: forall n a b. n = 2 * a -> n = 2 * b + 1 -> false
theorems.summary: An even and an odd decomposition of the same natural are incompatible.

theorems.name: even_not_odd
theorems.statement: forall n. (exists a. n = 2 * a) -> ~(exists b. n = 2 * b + 1)
theorems.summary: No even natural is odd.

theorems.name: odd_not_even
theorems.statement: forall n. (exists b. n = 2 * b + 1) -> ~(exists a. n = 2 * a)
theorems.summary: No odd natural is even.

theorems.name: successor_odd_of_even
theorems.statement: forall n. (exists a. n = 2 * a) -> exists b. S n = 2 * b + 1
theorems.summary: The successor of an even natural is odd.

theorems.name: successor_even_of_odd
theorems.statement: forall n. (exists a. n = 2 * a + 1) -> exists b. S n = 2 * b
theorems.summary: The successor of an odd natural is even.

theorems.name: even_add_even
theorems.statement: forall m n. (exists a. m = 2 * a) -> (exists b. n = 2 * b) -> exists c. m + n = 2 * c
theorems.summary: The sum of two even naturals is even.

theorems.name: even_add_odd
theorems.statement: forall m n. (exists a. m = 2 * a) -> (exists b. n = 2 * b + 1) -> exists c. m + n = 2 * c + 1
theorems.summary: An even natural plus an odd natural is odd.

theorems.name: odd_add_even
theorems.statement: forall m n. (exists a. m = 2 * a + 1) -> (exists b. n = 2 * b) -> exists c. m + n = 2 * c + 1
theorems.summary: An odd natural plus an even natural is odd.

theorems.name: odd_add_odd
theorems.statement: forall m n. (exists a. m = 2 * a + 1) -> (exists b. n = 2 * b + 1) -> exists c. m + n = 2 * c
theorems.summary: The sum of two odd naturals is even.

theorems.name: even_mul_left
theorems.statement: forall m n. (exists a. m = 2 * a) -> exists c. m * n = 2 * c
theorems.summary: A product with an even left factor is even.

theorems.name: mul_double_right
theorems.statement: forall m b. m * (2 * b) = 2 * (m * b)
theorems.summary: Doubling commutes through multiplication on the right.

theorems.name: even_mul_right
theorems.statement: forall m n. (exists b. n = 2 * b) -> exists c. m * n = 2 * c
theorems.summary: A product with an even right factor is even.

theorems.name: odd_mul_odd
theorems.statement: forall m n. (exists a. m = 2 * a + 1) -> (exists b. n = 2 * b + 1) -> exists c. m * n = 2 * c + 1
theorems.summary: The product of two odd naturals is odd.

theorems.name: odd_half_unique
theorems.statement: forall n a b. n = 2 * a + 1 -> n = 2 * b + 1 -> a = b
theorems.summary: The half witness in an odd decomposition is unique.

theorems.name: odd_half_exists_unique
theorems.statement: forall n. (exists a. n = 2 * a + 1) -> exists h. n = 2 * h + 1 /\ forall k. n = 2 * k + 1 -> h = k
theorems.summary: Every odd natural has a unique half witness.

theorems.name: four_mul_eq_double_double
theorems.statement: forall a. 4 * a = 2 * (2 * a)
theorems.summary: Multiplication by four is iterated doubling.

theorems.name: odd_mod4_cases
theorems.statement: forall n. (exists h. n = 2 * h + 1) -> (exists a. n = 4 * a + 1) \/ exists b. n = 4 * b + 3
theorems.summary: Every odd natural is congruent to one or three modulo four.

theorems.name: mod4_one_three_exclusive_pointwise
theorems.statement: forall n a b. n = 4 * a + 1 -> n = 4 * b + 3 -> false
theorems.summary: Residues one and three modulo four cannot describe the same natural.

theorems.name: mod4_one_is_odd
theorems.statement: forall n. (exists a. n = 4 * a + 1) -> exists h. n = 2 * h + 1
theorems.summary: A natural congruent to one modulo four is odd.

theorems.name: mod4_three_is_odd
theorems.statement: forall n. (exists a. n = 4 * a + 3) -> exists h. n = 2 * h + 1
theorems.summary: A natural congruent to three modulo four is odd.

theorems.name: prime_ne_two_is_odd
theorems.statement: forall p. (~(p = 1) /\ forall a b. p = a * b -> a = 1 \/ b = 1) -> ~(p = 2) -> exists h. p = 2 * h + 1
theorems.summary: Every prime other than two is odd.

theorems.name: mod_eq_decidable_from_remainders
script: have har : exists u v. a + p * u = ra + p * v
have hbr : exists u v. b + p * u = rb + p * v
have hbra : exists u v. b + p * u = ra + p * v
have hrab : exists u v. ra + p * u = b + p * v
have har : exists u v. a + p * u = ra + p * v
have hra_a : exists u v. ra + p * u = a + p * v
have hra_b : exists u v. ra + p * u = b + p * v
have hbr : exists u v. b + p * u = rb + p * v
theorems.statement: forall p a b qa ra qb rb. a = qa * p + ra -> (exists ha. ha + S ra = p) -> b = qb * p + rb -> (exists hb. hb + S rb = p) -> (exists u v. a + p * u = b + p * v) \/ ~(exists u v. a + p * u = b + p * v)
theorems.summary: Canonical bounded remainders constructively decide congruence.

theorems.name: mod_eq_decidable_nonzero
script: have hda : exists qa ra. a = p * qa + ra /\ exists ha. ha + S ra = p
have hdb : exists qb rb. b = p * qb + rb /\ exists hb. hb + S rb = p
have ha_comm : a = x * p + x1
have hb_comm : b = x2 * p + x3
theorems.statement: forall p a b. ~(p = 0) -> (exists qr_u_dec_yes qr_v_dec_yes. a + p * qr_u_dec_yes = b + p * qr_v_dec_yes) \/ ~(exists qr_u_dec_no qr_v_dec_no. a + p * qr_u_dec_no = b + p * qr_v_dec_no)
theorems.summary: Balanced congruence is constructively decidable at nonzero modulus.

theorems.name: quadratic_residue_search_up_to
script: have hdec : (exists u v. 0 * 0 + p * u = a + p * v) \/ ~(exists u v. 0 * 0 + p * u = a + p * v)
have hprev : (exists x. (exists h. h + x = B) /\ exists u v. x * x + p * u = a + p * v) \/ (forall x. (exists h. h + x = B) -> ~(exists u v. x * x + p * u = a + p * v))
have hdec : (exists u v. (S B) * (S B) + p * u = a + p * v) \/ ~(exists u v. (S B) * (S B) + p * u = a + p * v)
have hcases : x = S B \/ exists k. k + S x = S B
theorems.statement: forall B p a. ~(p = 0) -> ((exists qr_x_search_yes. (exists qr_bound_search_yes. qr_bound_search_yes + qr_x_search_yes = B) /\ (exists qr_u_search_yes qr_v_search_yes. qr_x_search_yes * qr_x_search_yes + p * qr_u_search_yes = a + p * qr_v_search_yes)) \/ (forall qr_x_search_no. (exists qr_bound_search_no. qr_bound_search_no + qr_x_search_no = B) -> ~(exists qr_u_search_no qr_v_search_no. qr_x_search_no * qr_x_search_no + p * qr_u_search_no = a + p * qr_v_search_no)))
theorems.summary: Inclusive bounded search constructively decides square congruence.

theorems.name: quadratic_residue_bounded_decidable_nonzero
script: have hs : exists B. p = S B
have hsearch : (exists r. (exists h. h + r = x) /\ exists u v. r * r + p * u = a + p * v) \/ (forall r. (exists h. h + r = x) -> ~(exists u v. r * r + p * u = a + p * v))
theorems.statement: forall p a. ~(p = 0) -> (exists qr_x_bounded. (exists qr_h_bounded. qr_h_bounded + S qr_x_bounded = p) /\ exists qr_u_bounded qr_v_bounded. qr_x_bounded * qr_x_bounded + p * qr_u_bounded = a + p * qr_v_bounded) \/ ~(exists qr_x_bounded. (exists qr_h_bounded. qr_h_bounded + S qr_x_bounded = p) /\ exists qr_u_bounded qr_v_bounded. qr_x_bounded * qr_x_bounded + p * qr_u_bounded = a + p * qr_v_bounded)
theorems.summary: A nonzero modulus admits a finite constructive residue search.

theorems.name: quadratic_residue_bounded_equiv
script: have hdivision : exists q r. x = p * q + r /\ exists h. h + S r = p
have hsquare : exists w. x * x = p * w + x2 * x2

have hrx : exists u v. x2 * x2 + p * u = x * x + p * v
have hra : exists u v. x2 * x2 + p * u = a + p * v
theorems.statement: forall p a. ~(p = 0) -> (((exists qr_x_unbounded. exists qr_u_unbounded qr_v_unbounded. qr_x_unbounded * qr_x_unbounded + p * qr_u_unbounded = a + p * qr_v_unbounded) -> (exists qr_x_bounded. (exists qr_h_bounded. qr_h_bounded + S qr_x_bounded = p) /\ exists qr_u_bounded qr_v_bounded. qr_x_bounded * qr_x_bounded + p * qr_u_bounded = a + p * qr_v_bounded)) /\ ((exists qr_x_bounded. (exists qr_h_bounded. qr_h_bounded + S qr_x_bounded = p) /\ exists qr_u_bounded qr_v_bounded. qr_x_bounded * qr_x_bounded + p * qr_u_bounded = a + p * qr_v_bounded) -> (exists qr_x_unbounded. exists qr_u_unbounded qr_v_unbounded. qr_x_unbounded * qr_x_unbounded + p * qr_u_unbounded = a + p * qr_v_unbounded)))
theorems.summary: Every square witness has an equivalent canonical bounded root.

theorems.name: quadratic_residue_decidable_nonzero
script: have hequiv : (((exists x. exists u v. x * x + p * u = a + p * v) -> (exists r. (exists h. h + S r = p) /\ exists u v. r * r + p * u = a + p * v)) /\ ((exists r. (exists h. h + S r = p) /\ exists u v. r * r + p * u = a + p * v) -> (exists x. exists u v. x * x + p * u = a + p * v)))
have hdec : (exists r. (exists h. h + S r = p) /\ exists u v. r * r + p * u = a + p * v) \/ ~(exists r. (exists h. h + S r = p) /\ exists u v. r * r + p * u = a + p * v)
theorems.statement: forall p a. ~(p = 0) -> (exists qr_x_unbounded. exists qr_u_unbounded qr_v_unbounded. qr_x_unbounded * qr_x_unbounded + p * qr_u_unbounded = a + p * qr_v_unbounded) \/ ~(exists qr_x_unbounded. exists qr_u_unbounded qr_v_unbounded. qr_x_unbounded * qr_x_unbounded + p * qr_u_unbounded = a + p * qr_v_unbounded)
theorems.summary: Quadratic residuosity is constructively decidable at nonzero modulus.

theorems.name: beta_repeat_empty
theorems.statement: forall b c a l. l = 0 -> (forall ff_i_empty. (exists ff_lt_empty_bound. ff_lt_empty_bound + S ff_i_empty = l) -> (((exists ff_h_empty_decoded. ff_h_empty_decoded + S (a) = S ((S (ff_i_empty)) * c)) /\ exists ff_q_empty_decoded. b = ff_q_empty_decoded * S ((S (ff_i_empty)) * c) + (a))))

have hsplit : i = l \/ exists h. h + S i = l
theorems.statement: forall b c a l sl. sl = S l -> (forall ff_i_before. (exists ff_lt_before_bound. ff_lt_before_bound + S ff_i_before = l) -> (((exists ff_h_before_decoded. ff_h_before_decoded + S (a) = S ((S (ff_i_before)) * c)) /\ exists ff_q_before_decoded. b = ff_q_before_decoded * S ((S (ff_i_before)) * c) + (a)))) -> exists z d. (forall ff_i_after. (exists ff_lt_after_bound. ff_lt_after_bound + S ff_i_after = sl) -> (((exists ff_h_after_decoded. ff_h_after_decoded + S (a) = S ((S (ff_i_after)) * d)) /\ exists ff_q_after_decoded. z = ff_q_after_decoded * S ((S (ff_i_after)) * d) + (a))))
theorems.summary: Recode a constant prefix and append one more copy of its value.

theorems.name: beta_repeat_exists
theorems.statement: forall a l. exists b c. (forall ff_i_r. (exists ff_lt_r_bound. ff_lt_r_bound + S ff_i_r = l) -> (((exists ff_h_r_decoded. ff_h_r_decoded + S (a) = S ((S (ff_i_r)) * c)) /\ exists ff_q_r_decoded. b = ff_q_r_decoded * S ((S (ff_i_r)) * c) + (a))))
theorems.summary: Every value and length admit a beta-coded constant prefix.

(exists ff_lt_entry_bound. ff_lt_entry_bound + S ff_i_entry = l) -> (((exists ff_h_entry_decoded. ff_h_entry_decoded + S (a) = S ((S (ff_i_entry)) * c)) /\ exists ff_q_entry_decoded. b = ff_q_entry_decoded * S ((S (ff_i_entry)) * c) + (a)))) -> (exists h. h + S i = l) -> (((exists ff_h_entry_x. ff_h_entry_x + S (x) = S ((S (i)) * c)) /\ exists ff_q_entry_x. b = ff_q_entry_x * S ((S (i)) * c) + (x))) -> x = a
theorems.summary: Every decoded entry of a Repeat prefix equals its repeated value.

theorems.name: beta_repeat_transport_entry

(exists ff_lt_transport_r_bound. ff_lt_transport_r_bound + S ff_i_transport_r = l) -> (((exists ff_h_transport_r_decoded. ff_h_transport_r_decoded + S (a) = S ((S (ff_i_transport_r)) * d)) /\ exists ff_q_transport_r_decoded. z = ff_q_transport_r_decoded * S ((S (ff_i_transport_r)) * d) + (a)))) -> forall i x. (exists h. h + S i = l) -> (((exists ff_h_transport_x. ff_h_transport_x + S (x) = S ((S (i)) * c)) /\ exists ff_q_transport_x. b = ff_q_transport_x * S ((S (i)) * c) + (x))) -> (((exists ff_h_transport_y. ff_h_transport_y + S (x) = S ((S (i)) * d)) /\ exists ff_q_transport_y. z = ff_q_transport_y * S ((S (i)) * d) + (x)))
